entries.zh: 耄耋；年寿极高（八九十岁）、极老之人
entries.en: very old man, one of extreme old age (eighty or ninety years)

entries.zh: 耆老；六十岁的老人，年高之长者
entries.en: old man of sixty years; aged elder

entries.zh: 年高之人；原字「鰲」罕见，据西栏 Viejo 与「人」字定为老者称谓（字义存疑）
entries.en: an aged person (rare character 鰲, read guân; character sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字「鰲」义罕不明，仅凭西语 Viejo、「人」字与闽南音写 guân 判为年老者称谓，故降为中置信

entries.zh: 老人；年迈之人、长者
entries.en: old man; elderly person

entries.zh: 老大；排行最年长者，亦指一伙人的头目、大哥
entries.en: eldest by age order; head man, chief of a group

entries.zh: 老相；苍老之相、显得年老的样子
entries.en: aged appearance; old-looking

entries.zh: 年老；年纪老迈
entries.en: old in years, aged

entries.zh: 年长；年纪较长
entries.en: senior in age, elder

entries.zh: 古老；极老、年代久远〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: very old; ancient, of great age
entries.notes: 西语栏截断且尾部残损（se pica adelante, alcache de años, obxrog [残]难以解读），据汉字古老与闽南音定极老/古老之义，整体降为低置信

entries.zh: 老爹；对年长男子的尊称（老伯、老爷子）
entries.en: honored old man; respectful address for an elderly man ('old father')

entries.zh: 老爷；对长者、主家或官长之尊称
entries.en: 'old lord', master; respectful title for an elder or person of standing

entries.zh: 老者无能；老而无用、老朽不中用
entries.en: old man who is incapable or useless; infirm elder past usefulness

entries.zh: 老耄；衰老昏耄、年迈体衰
entries.en: decrepit old age; senile old man

entries.zh: 孤老；孤独无依、贫无所靠的老人
entries.en: lonely, destitute old man without support

entries.zh: 古旧；陈旧、年代久远
entries.en: old, ancient; long in use, worn with age

entries.zh: 旧时人；旧时代、往昔之人
entries.en: person of former times; man of the old days

entries.zh: 绅长；士绅之长、地方耆绅长老
entries.en: noble elder; gentry dignitary, respected local elder

entries.zh: 老公；老翁、对年高男子的尊称
entries.en: old man; aged gentleman, respectful address for an elderly man

entries.zh: 白须；白胡子，指须发皆白的老人
entries.en: white beard; hoary old man, white-whiskered

entries.zh: 家长；一家之长、户主
entries.en: head of the household; family patriarch

entries.zh: 耆老；六十岁的老人（与前第2条同词重出）
entries.en: old man of sixty years; aged elder
